package datahub

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"runtime"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"icode.baidu.com/baidu/gdp/datahub"
	"icode.baidu.com/baidu/gdp/logit"
)

var IgnoreErr = errors.New("error ignore")

type DataHubConf struct {
	PipeConf  *PipeConf
	QueueConf *QueueConf
}

type PipeConf struct {
	PipeName string
}

type QueueConf struct {
	Name                string
	Token               string
	WindowSize          int32
	QueueNum            int
	FailedMaxRetryTimes int
	FailedRetryDuration int // second
}

type Message interface {
	Data() datahub.QueueData
}

type ConsumerPool struct {
	client    datahub.Client
	conf      *QueueConf
	logger    logit.Logger
	poolSize  int
	wg        sync.WaitGroup
	processFn func(result Message) error
}

func NewConsumerPool(client datahub.Client, poolSize int, conf *QueueConf, logger logit.Logger) *ConsumerPool {
	c := &ConsumerPool{
		client:   client,
		conf:     conf,
		logger:   logger,
		poolSize: poolSize,
	}
	// 默认失败重试间隔
	if c.conf.FailedRetryDuration == 0 {
		c.conf.FailedRetryDuration = 10
	}
	// 默认失败重试次数
	if c.conf.FailedMaxRetryTimes == 0 {
		c.conf.FailedMaxRetryTimes = 10
	}
	// 默认大小
	if c.poolSize <= 0 {
		c.poolSize = 1
	}
	if c.conf.Name == "" || c.conf.Token == "" || c.conf.WindowSize == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return c
}

func (c *ConsumerPool) GetName() string {
	return c.conf.Name
}

func (c *ConsumerPool) GetDuration() time.Duration {
	return 0
}

func (c *ConsumerPool) GetStartRun() bool {
	return false
}

func (c *ConsumerPool) GetFailedSendMessage() bool {
	return true
}

// process方法返回Ignore消息会被忽略，返回nil会ack，返回错误会ackagain
func (c *ConsumerPool) SetProcessFunc(fn func(result Message) error) {
	c.processFn = fn
}

func (c *ConsumerPool) Run(ctx context.Context) error {
	for i := 0; i < c.poolSize; i++ {
		for j := 0; j < c.conf.QueueNum; j++ {
			c.wg.Add(1)
			go c.consume(ctx, j+1)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (c *ConsumerPool) consume(ctx context.Context, queueIndex int) {
	defer func() {
		if e := recover(); e != nil {
			buff := make([]byte, 1<<10)
			runtime.Stack(buff, false)
			log.Println(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("consume pipe panic!!! %v %s", e, string(buff)))
		}
	}()
	// 只有QueueNum > 1 的时候，才需要通过拼接生成 queue 名称
	queueName := c.conf.Name
	if c.conf.QueueNum > 1 {
		queueName = fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d", c.conf.Name, queueIndex)
	}

	var failedTimes int
	defer c.wg.Done()
	ctx, cancelFn := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	defer cancelFn()
	caller := logit.CallerFieldWithSkip(1)
	logit.ReplaceFields(ctx, caller)
	c.logger.Notice(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("start consumer name=%s wokerNum=%d", queueName, c.poolSize))
	ctx.Deadline()
RESTART:
	if failedTimes >= c.conf.FailedMaxRetryTimes || errors.Is(ctx.Err(), context.DeadlineExceeded) || errors.Is(ctx.Err(), context.Canceled) {
		return
	}
	ch := make(chan datahub.QueueResult)
	if err := c.client.Queue(ctx, queueName, c.conf.Token, c.conf.WindowSize, ch); err != nil {
		c.logger.Error(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("queue error name=%s err=%s", queueName, err.Error()))
		failedTimes++
		time.Sleep(time.Second * time.Duration(c.conf.FailedRetryDuration))
		goto RESTART
	}
	failedTimes = 0
	for {
		select {
		case msg := <-ch:
			if msg.Err() != nil {
				time.Sleep(time.Second * time.Duration(c.conf.FailedRetryDuration))
				goto RESTART
			}
			// c.logger.Notice(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("consume success queue=%s msg=%s", queueName, string(msg.Data().Data)))
			err := c.processFn(msg)
			if err == nil || err == IgnoreErr {
				// c.logger.Notice(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("process finished ack queue=%s msg=%s err=%+v", queueName, string(msg.Data().Data), err))
				if err := msg.Ack(ctx); err != nil {
					c.logger.Warning(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("ack again queue=%s msg=%s err=%s", queueName, string(msg.Data().Data), err.Error()))
				}
				continue
			}
			c.logger.Notice(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("process finished ack again queue=%s msg=%s err=%+v", queueName, string(msg.Data().Data), err))
			_ = msg.AckAgain(ctx)
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		}
	}
}

	"icode.baidu.com/baidu/gdp/datahub"

var IgnoreErr = errors.New("error ignore")

type DataHubConf struct {
	PipeConf  *PipeConf
	QueueConf *QueueConf
}

type PipeConf struct {
	PipeName string
}

type QueueConf struct {
	Name                string
	Token               string
	WindowSize          int32
	QueueNum            int
	FailedMaxRetryTimes int
	FailedRetryDuration int // second
}

type Message interface {
	Data() datahub.QueueData
}

type ConsumerPool struct {
	client    datahub.Client
	conf      *QueueConf
	logger    logit.Logger
	poolSize  int
	wg        sync.WaitGroup
	processFn func(result Message) error
}

func NewConsumerPool(client datahub.Client, poolSize int, conf *QueueConf, logger logit.Logger) *ConsumerPool {
	c := &ConsumerPool{
		client:   client,
		conf:     conf,
		logger:   logger,
		poolSize: poolSize,
	}
	// 默认失败重试间隔
	if c.conf.FailedRetryDuration == 0 {
		c.conf.FailedRetryDuration = 10
	}
	// 默认失败重试次数
	if c.conf.FailedMaxRetryTimes == 0 {
		c.conf.FailedMaxRetryTimes = 10
	}
	// 默认大小
	if c.poolSize <= 0 {
		c.poolSize = 1
	}
	if c.conf.Name == "" || c.conf.Token == "" || c.conf.WindowSize == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return c
}

func (c *ConsumerPool) GetName() string {
	return c.conf.Name
}

func (c *ConsumerPool) GetDuration() time.Duration {
	return 0
}

func (c *ConsumerPool) GetStartRun() bool {
	return false
}

func (c *ConsumerPool) GetFailedSendMessage() bool {
	return true
}

// process方法返回Ignore消息会被忽略，返回nil会ack，返回错误会ackagain
func (c *ConsumerPool) SetProcessFunc(fn func(result Message) error) {
	c.processFn = fn
}

func (c *ConsumerPool) Run(ctx context.Context) error {
	for i := 0; i < c.poolSize; i++ {
		for j := 0; j < c.conf.QueueNum; j++ {
			c.wg.Add(1)
			go c.consume(ctx, j+1)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (c *ConsumerPool) consume(ctx context.Context, queueIndex int) {
	defer func() {
		if e := recover(); e != nil {
			buff := make([]byte, 1<<10)
			runtime.Stack(buff, false)
			log.Println(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("consume pipe panic!!! %v %s", e, string(buff)))
		}
	}()
	// 只有QueueNum > 1 的时候，才需要通过拼接生成 queue 名称
	queueName := c.conf.Name
	if c.conf.QueueNum > 1 {
		queueName = fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d", c.conf.Name, queueIndex)
	}

	var failedTimes int
	defer c.wg.Done()
	ctx, cancelFn := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	defer cancelFn()
	caller := logit.CallerFieldWithSkip(1)
	logit.ReplaceFields(ctx, caller)
	c.logger.Notice(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("start consumer name=%s wokerNum=%d", queueName, c.poolSize))
	ctx.Deadline()
RESTART:
	if failedTimes >= c.conf.FailedMaxRetryTimes || errors.Is(ctx.Err(), context.DeadlineExceeded) || errors.Is(ctx.Err(), context.Canceled) {
		return
	}
	ch := make(chan datahub.QueueResult)
	if err := c.client.Queue(ctx, queueName, c.conf.Token, c.conf.WindowSize, ch); err != nil {
		c.logger.Error(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("queue error name=%s err=%s", queueName, err.Error()))
		failedTimes++
		time.Sleep(time.Second * time.Duration(c.conf.FailedRetryDuration))
		goto RESTART
	}
	failedTimes = 0
	for {
		select {
		case msg := <-ch:
			if msg.Err() != nil {
				time.Sleep(time.Second * time.Duration(c.conf.FailedRetryDuration))
				goto RESTART
			}
			// c.logger.Notice(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("consume success queue=%s msg=%s", queueName, string(msg.Data().Data)))
			err := c.processFn(msg)
			if err == nil || err == IgnoreErr {
				// c.logger.Notice(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("process finished ack queue=%s msg=%s err=%+v", queueName, string(msg.Data().Data), err))
				if err := msg.Ack(ctx); err != nil {
					c.logger.Warning(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("ack again queue=%s msg=%s err=%s", queueName, string(msg.Data().Data), err.Error()))
				}
				continue
			}
			c.logger.Notice(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("process finished ack again queue=%s msg=%s err=%+v", queueName, string(msg.Data().Data), err))
			_ = msg.AckAgain(ctx)
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		}
	}
}

        处理单条消息

        """

        data = message.get("data", "")

        logger.info(f"消息内容: {data}")
        
        try:
            if callback:
                # 使用用户提供的回调函数处理消息
                success = callback(data)

                success = True
            
            if success:

                return False

        """

        message_count = 0
        running = True
        
        def signal_handler(sig, frame):
            nonlocal running
            logger.info("接收到停止信号，正在停止...")
            running = False
        
        # 注册信号处理器
        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal_handler)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal_handler)
        
        try:
            while running:
                if max_messages and message_count >= max_messages:
                    logger.info(f"达到最大消息数限制: {max_messages}")
                    break
                
                messages = self.receive_messages()
                
                if messages:
                    for message in messages:
                        if not running:  # 检查是否应该停止
                            break
                            
                        success = self.process_message(message, callback)
                        if success:

                            logger.info(f"已处理消息数: {message_count}")
                
                # 如果没有消息或达到限制，等待下一次轮询
                if running and (not messages or (max_messages and message_count < max_messages)):
                    time.sleep(interval)
                    
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            logger.info("用户中断消费")
        except Exception as e:
